description: Composes the four prior rungs into a single signed end-to-end trace. VerifiedRepairTraceRunner walks: BuildAdapterRegistry.select → ModelRouter.route (per task class) → MockModelClient.invoke → SafePatchWorkspace.apply_and_verify → injected verifier callable → trace assembly. The output is a VerifiedRepairTrace whose trace_id is sha256-derived from (workspace, salt, canned_kind) and whose trace_fingerprint is sha256 over the canonical JSON body. Source repo is never mutated (sha256 tree before==after enforced through the safe-patch workspace). corpus_eligibility=BLOCKED_BY_DEFAULT and training_eligible=False on every trace, regardless of outcome.
purpose: Rung 4 of the verified-repair campaign. This is the apparatus proof — the moment the four pillars compose cleanly. Sets up HUMAN_APPROVAL_SOURCE_MUTATION_GATE_LOCK_001 (the next rung) to gate the eventual original-repo write against a trace_id + diff hash + verifier-passed evidence packet.
invariants: VerifiedRepairTrace.trace_id is sha256(workspace + salt + canned_kind) — reproducible from inputs.
VerifiedRepairTrace.trace_fingerprint = sha256(canonical JSON of trace) — stable across repeated to_json() calls of the same trace.
The runner composes BuildAdapterRegistry + ModelRouter + MockModelClient + SafePatchWorkspace + verifier callable. No new I/O surface is introduced.
Unsupported repo (UnknownAdapter) short-circuits with TRACE_BLOCKED_UNSUPPORTED_REPO; safe_patch_result is empty; no mock invocation.
Source-preservation: workspace sha256 tree is unchanged after every run, across all five fixtures, in both verifier-pass and verifier-fail paths.
corpus_eligibility is always 'BLOCKED_BY_DEFAULT' and training_eligible is always False on every trace path.
scripts/repair/verified_repair_trace.py and verified_repair_trace_record.py contain no `import subprocess`, no `import urllib`, no `import socket`, no `import http`.

The runner never invokes BuildAdapter.run_shadow_build on the original workspace — that would trigger a real toolchain. Real-toolchain integration is opt-in via the verifier argument; tests use stub verifiers.
Audit counts: BLOCKED_UNSAFE=0, MUST_MIGRATE=0, UNKNOWN=0, PROGRAMBENCH>=56.
remaining_gaps: Tests use stub verifiers (always pass / always fail). BuildAdapter-backed verifiers that run cargo check / pytest on the temp workspace are opt-in (caller passes a real verifier); not exercised by the lock's focused tests.
Trace_fingerprint includes the temp_workspace path, which varies across runs. trace_id is the input-derived invariant; trace_fingerprint is the output-derived invariant.
Trace records are NOT yet wired into the evidence_index as machine-readable corpus rows. Corpus admission is gated by CORPUS_ELIGIBILITY_REPAIR_TRACE_GUARD_LOCK_001 (next-next rung).
